verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents its own ways to move data out: data-out integrations send data to outside platforms, the App API can fetch data, and the CLI returns structured JSON with full workspace access. None of these is documented as a complete, bulk export of all workspace data for leaving the platform. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk export feature, explicit coverage of all data types (profiles, events, messages, automations, assets), documented open export formats beyond API JSON, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Data-out integrations let you send data to platforms outside of Customer.io, like analytics platforms, CRMs, support tools, advertising platforms, messaging platforms, and more.
To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
Every command returns structured JSON, every endpoint is self-describing via `cio schema`
The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces.
